fact: The cell door was left open in the morning.
source_quote: the cell door had been left open
subject: cell door left open

fact: Stool is a small myconid sprout who has become an unlikely ally to the prisoners.
source_quote: Stool, the small myconid sprout who had become an unlikely ally
subject: Stool

fact: Stool scatters rapport spores throughout the cell to establish a telepathic link.
source_quote: Stool happily scatters rapport spores throughout the cell, establishing a telepathic link among the prisoners
subject: rapport spores deployed

fact: Rapport spores allow affected creatures to communicate telepathically for an hour.
source_quote: The spores allow affected creatures to communicate for an hour
subject: rapport spores

fact: Rapport spores function within roughly thirty feet of Stool.
source_quote: The link initially connects creatures gathered near Stool and remains usable within roughly thirty feet
subject: rapport spores

fact: Thorin is a dwarf warrior.
source_quote: Thorin, the dwarf warrior
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin possesses a pendant fashioned from a giant's tooth which serves as a family memento.
source_quote: Thorin, the dwarf warrior, felt the absence of his family’s memento — a pendant fashioned from a giant’s tooth
subject: Thorin's pendant

fact: The prisoners debate making a straight dash for freedom or detouring to the guard tower’s armory.
source_quote: The group debated whether to make a straight dash for freedom or risk a detour to the guard tower’s armory
subject: escape strategy debate

fact: The prisoners' confiscated personal belongings are held in Ilvara’s quarters.
source_quote: Their confiscated personal belongings were held elsewhere, in Ilvara’s quarters
subject: gear location discussed

fact: The outpost’s interior chambers are dimly illuminated by lanterns containing phosphorescent fungi.
source_quote: The outpost’s interior chambers were dimly illuminated by lanterns containing phosphorescent fungi
subject: drow outpost interior

fact: The exterior of the drow outpost remains dark.
source_quote: the exterior remained dark
subject: drow outpost exterior

fact: The drow conscripts in the nearby barracks are inattentive and accustomed to uneventful duty.
source_quote: The drow in the nearby barracks were inattentive conscripts accustomed to uneventful duty
subject: drow conscripts

fact: The drow guards at the lookout are watching outward rather than back toward the prison.
source_quote: the guards at the lookout watched outward rather than back toward the prison
subject: drow lookouts

fact: The group determines that ordinary footsteps might pass unnoticed, but screams, fire, or forced doors would alert the outpost.
source_quote: Ordinary footsteps might pass unnoticed, but a scream, a burst of fire, or the sound of the massive cell door being forced would bring the outpost down upon the prisoners
subject: stealth assessment

fact: The group settles on a cautious infiltration of the guard post with the others ready to charge if it fails.
source_quote: The group therefore settled on a cautious infiltration of the guard post, with everyone else ready to charge if the attempt failed
subject: infiltration plan set

fact: Prince Derendil offers to provide muscle for the mission.
source_quote: Prince Derendil offered muscle rather than subtlety
subject: Prince Derendil

fact: Buppido argues that the divine plan requires someone else to secure weapons first.
source_quote: Buppido argued that the “divine plan” required somebody else to secure the weapons first
subject: Buppido

fact: Zalthir volunteers to approach the guard post due to his high stealth capability.
source_quote: Zalthir, the group’s most capable infiltrator, went forward with Daz
subject: Zalthir

fact: Daz accompanies Zalthir to use magical tricks if they are discovered.
source_quote: went forward with Daz, whose magical tricks might salvage the situation if they were discovered
subject: Daz

fact: The Dungeon Master confirms Zalthir's fiery breath can ignite a five-foot area but is limited to two uses per long rest.
source_quote: confirms that Zalthir’s fiery breath can ignite a five-foot area... though he can use the ability only twice per long rest
subject: Zalthir's ability clarified

fact: The group rejects sending Prince Derendil ahead because Quaggoths working the outpost would react badly.
source_quote: The group considers sending Prince Derendil ahead because Quaggoths work in the outpost, but rejects the idea as likely to produce havoc and noise
subject: Prince Derendil rejected

fact: Zalthir rolls disastrously and trips as he enters the guard post.
source_quote: Zalthir tripped as he entered
subject: Zalthir fails stealth

fact: Daz rolls poorly and kicks a can while trying to catch Zalthir.
source_quote: Daz’s attempt to catch him only kicked a can across the floor
subject: Daz fails stealth

fact: Two drow guards were idly playing cards before being alerted.
source_quote: Two drow who had been idly playing cards looked up from their game
subject: drow guards

fact: The drow guards notice Zalthir and Daz, shattering the hope of a quiet escape.
source_quote: Two drow who had been idly playing cards looked up from their game... the hope of a quiet escape shattered
subject: stealth broken

fact: The plan changes instantly from stealth to a charge as the guards are alerted.
source_quote: With the guards alerted and the telepathic link carrying the news back to the prisoners, the plan changes instantly from stealth to a charge
subject: plan changes to charge
